title: Two people rushed to hospital after village crash involving three cyclists
content: Two people have been rushed to hospital with serious injuries after a crash involving three cyclists. Police were called to the collision on the B1040 Airfield Road in Warboys at around 6.50pm on Thursday (September 24). Emergency services rushed to the scene and two people were taken to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge with serious injuries. One person was treated at the scene for minor injuries and the road was temporarily closed, Cambridgeshire Constabulary confirmed. No other vehicles were involved.
